# Memory write (memory.write)

## categories

[
  "memory"
]

## demonstrations

[
  {
    "expected_output": {
      "key": "idea",
      "revision": 1
    },
    "id": "basic",
    "input": {
      "key": "idea",
      "value": "Keep notes in NOTES.md."
    },
    "title": "Empty workspace memory example"
  }
]

## description

Store a named text note in this run’s durable SQLite memory. Memory is agent-owned state at .memory.sqlite in the workspace. NOTES.md is the convention for free-form working notes; it is not created automatically. Memory contains no permissions or supervisor state. Read operations return an empty list before the first write.

## failure_modes

[
  {
    "condition": "Database is corrupt, locked or inaccessible.",
    "recovery": "Use working notes in NOTES.md; memory may need restoring from a checkpoint.",
    "symptom": "Capability error."
  }
]
